criteria.interpretation: Per HTTP deployment, median run outcomes compared with each retained legacy configuration; periodic stability compared with the smaller baseline median. A recovery bin qualifies at >=95% scheduled critical success within100ms with zero server/transport errors, requiring two consecutive full1s bins. Zero means the first pair starts at phase start, not instantaneous recovery. Preset configuration footprint is measured; this is not a human tuning-effort study.

methodology.scope: Local database-backed controller evaluation, not production capacity or a multi-host claim.
methodology.signal: Controlled global cap4 in final phase; source collector100ms, maxAge600ms. Tests coordination, not automatic detection.
methodology.measurement: Open-loop Go arrivals; no retries; 3s client and1s SQL deadlines. Phase controls switch only after responses and SQL drain. No claim of independent per-scenario experiments.
methodology.selection: Exploratory pilot findings informed the candidate. Published comparisons use this fixed-code repeated matrix; legacy defaults are retained alongside the earlier tuned reference.
